yamlCheck.dateAnchor: April 12, 1748 is supplied only by YAML; the transcript independently establishes mid-afternoon after the rest.
yamlCheck.explanation: Continuous exploration from the immediate aftermath of the roper fight to the locked eastern gate includes a short rest but no overnight or day change. This supports the zero-boundary span conditional on the YAML date. Opening reports of refugees and older wars do not extend the played interval.
